integrity: Proof and exact finite formula provided; reproducible independent finite LP and arithmetic checks supplied; unindexed equivalences cannot be excluded; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed distinct integer quotas at least two; independently labeled resource types; condition on meeting both quotas; no correlated supply or growing quota analysis. Deterministic core structure is a specialization of known matroid core theory; stochastic probability and critical-window limit are the claim.
title: Arithmetic core survival and a Gaussian supply-mix window for two-quota matroid packing games
